# Generated by ppc finalize (arable_land_bar.py); do not edit by hand.
# Location scope, read only by the population and capacity bars of the location view, in thousands of people:
# capacity = the townsfolk's own room + the arable land left (land + improvements - farms).

# Capacity multiplier as the engine applies it: (1 + local % + the owner's global %) x (1 + total %)
pp_land_bar_multiplier = {
	value = 1
	add = modifier:local_population_capacity_modifier
	# owner ?= (vanilla's form): `exists = owner` let a placeholder country through and logged a script error per view
	owner ?= { add = modifier:global_population_capacity_modifier }
	multiply = { value = 1 add = modifier:total_population_capacity_modifier }
	min = 0
}

# People, in thousands: the subsistence peasants live on the arable land, everyone else (the townsfolk) brings their
# own capacity (total_population +1 for every person, unemployed_peasants -1 for every subsistence peasant)
pp_land_bar_population = { value = population }
pp_land_bar_subsistence = { value = "unemployed_pops_of_pop_type_in_location(pop_type:peasants)" }
pp_land_bar_townsfolk = { value = pp_land_bar_population subtract = pp_land_bar_subsistence min = 0 }

# Flat capacity units: the arable land left is the capacity without the townsfolk's own; the farms (and reserved
# grounds) take land, the location's own land is what stays when the improvements and the farms are taken out again
pp_land_bar_left_flat = { value = modifier:local_population_capacity subtract = pp_land_bar_townsfolk }
pp_land_bar_taken_flat = { value = pp_land_bar_farms_flat add = pp_land_bar_reserved_flat }
pp_land_bar_natural_flat = {
	value = pp_land_bar_left_flat
	add = pp_land_bar_taken_flat
	subtract = pp_land_bar_improvements_flat
	min = 0
}

# In thousands of people (the capacity multiplier applied)
pp_land_bar_townsfolk_room = { value = pp_land_bar_townsfolk multiply = pp_land_bar_multiplier }
pp_land_bar_left = { value = pp_land_bar_left_flat multiply = pp_land_bar_multiplier }
pp_land_bar_left_shown = { value = pp_land_bar_left min = 0 }
pp_land_bar_farms = { value = pp_land_bar_taken_flat multiply = pp_land_bar_multiplier }
pp_land_bar_natural = { value = pp_land_bar_natural_flat multiply = pp_land_bar_multiplier }
pp_land_bar_improvements = { value = pp_land_bar_improvements_flat multiply = pp_land_bar_multiplier }
pp_land_bar_room = { value = pp_land_bar_room_flat multiply = pp_land_bar_multiplier }
# the land the farms hold, as far as there is land (farms beyond the location's land and improvements hold nothing more)
pp_land_bar_farms_shown = {
	value = pp_land_bar_left
	add = pp_land_bar_farms
	subtract = pp_land_bar_left_shown
	min = 0
}
pp_land_bar_capacity = { value = pp_land_bar_townsfolk_room add = pp_land_bar_left_shown }
pp_land_bar_percent = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { pp_land_bar_capacity > 0 } value = pp_land_bar_population divide = pp_land_bar_capacity multiply = 100 }
}

# Bar fractions (0..1) on one scale for both bars: the population, or the capacity with the farms' land and the room
# for improvements past its end
pp_land_bar_held = { value = pp_land_bar_capacity add = pp_land_bar_farms_shown }
pp_land_bar_scale_land = { value = pp_land_bar_held add = pp_land_bar_room }
pp_land_bar_scale = {
	value = pp_land_bar_scale_land
	if = { limit = { pp_land_bar_population > pp_land_bar_scale_land } value = pp_land_bar_population }
	min = 0.001
}
pp_land_bar_f_population = { value = pp_land_bar_population divide = pp_land_bar_scale }
pp_land_bar_f_within = { value = pp_land_bar_f_population max = pp_land_bar_f_capacity }
pp_land_bar_f_townsfolk = { value = pp_land_bar_townsfolk divide = pp_land_bar_scale }
pp_land_bar_f_townsfolk_room = { value = pp_land_bar_townsfolk_room divide = pp_land_bar_scale }
pp_land_bar_f_capacity = { value = pp_land_bar_capacity divide = pp_land_bar_scale }
pp_land_bar_f_held = { value = pp_land_bar_held divide = pp_land_bar_scale }
pp_land_bar_f_land = { value = pp_land_bar_scale_land divide = pp_land_bar_scale }

# Land the standing improvements add (raw_modifier capacity per level)
pp_land_bar_improvements_flat = {
	value = 0
	add = { value = modifier:pp_wb_levels_bund multiply = 5 }
	add = { value = modifier:pp_wb_levels_field_drainage multiply = 5 }
	add = { value = modifier:pp_wb_levels_field_management multiply = 5 }
	add = { value = modifier:pp_wb_levels_field_management_convertible multiply = 7.5 }
	add = { value = modifier:pp_wb_levels_field_management_improved multiply = 10 }
	add = { value = modifier:pp_wb_levels_incamisana multiply = 7.5 }
	if = { limit = { has_building = building_type:irrigated_fields } add = { value = "location_building_level(building_type:irrigated_fields)" multiply = 5 } }
	add = { value = modifier:pp_wb_levels_irrigation_systems multiply = 5 }
	add = { value = modifier:pp_wb_levels_jiangnan_canal_network multiply = 12.5 }
	add = { value = modifier:pp_wb_levels_jiangnan_hill_terraces multiply = 15 }
	add = { value = modifier:pp_wb_levels_khmer_baray multiply = 7.5 }
	if = { limit = { has_building = building_type:land_clearance } add = { value = "location_building_level(building_type:land_clearance)" multiply = 5 } }
	add = { value = modifier:pp_wb_levels_paddy_water_control multiply = 5 }
	add = { value = modifier:pp_wb_levels_polders multiply = 5 }
	add = { value = modifier:pp_wb_levels_qanats multiply = 5 }
}

	value = pp_wb_cap_field_management_shared
	max = 15
	if = { limit = { has_building = building_type:field_management } subtract = "location_building_level(building_type:field_management)" }
	if = { limit = { has_building = building_type:field_management_convertible } subtract = "location_building_level(building_type:field_management_convertible)" }
	if = { limit = { has_building = building_type:field_management_improved } subtract = "location_building_level(building_type:field_management_improved)" }
	if = { limit = { has_building = building_type:jiangnan_hill_terraces } subtract = "location_building_level(building_type:jiangnan_hill_terraces)" }
	min = 0
	multiply = pp_land_bar_room_field_management_shared_land
}

pp_land_bar_room_water_control_shared = {
	value = pp_wb_cap_water_control_shared
	max = 15
	if = { limit = { has_building = building_type:irrigation_systems } subtract = "location_building_level(building_type:irrigation_systems)" }
	if = { limit = { has_building = building_type:polders } subtract = "location_building_level(building_type:polders)" }
	if = { limit = { has_building = building_type:incamisana } subtract = "location_building_level(building_type:incamisana)" }
	if = { limit = { has_building = building_type:bund } subtract = "location_building_level(building_type:bund)" }
	if = { limit = { has_building = building_type:khmer_baray } subtract = "location_building_level(building_type:khmer_baray)" }
	if = { limit = { has_building = building_type:field_drainage } subtract = "location_building_level(building_type:field_drainage)" }
	if = { limit = { has_building = building_type:qanats } subtract = "location_building_level(building_type:qanats)" }
	min = 0
	multiply = pp_land_bar_room_water_control_shared_land
}
pp_land_bar_room_water_control_shared_land = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { OR = { has_river = yes is_adjacent_to_lake = yes OR = { topography = ha1300_topo_deltas topography = ha1300_topo_floodplains topography = ha1300_topo_valleys } AND = { has_location_modifier = pp_wb_coastal OR = { topography = flatland topography = wetlands } } } } value = 7.5 }
	else_if = { limit = { dominant_culture ?= culture:khmer_culture OR = { has_river = yes is_adjacent_to_lake = yes OR = { topography = ha1300_topo_deltas topography = ha1300_topo_floodplains topography = ha1300_topo_valleys } AND = { has_location_modifier = pp_wb_coastal OR = { topography = flatland topography = wetlands } } } } value = 7.5 }
	else_if = { limit = { OR = { has_river = yes OR = { topography = ha1300_topo_floodplains topography = wetlands topography = ha1300_topo_deltas } OR = { vegetation = ha1300_veg_marsh vegetation = ha1300_veg_swamp } AND = { OR = { climate = continental climate = ha1300_climate_continental_monsoon climate = ha1300_climate_dry_summer_continental climate = oceanic climate = ha1300_climate_subpolar_oceanic climate = mediterranean climate = subtropical climate = ha1300_climate_subtropical_monsoon climate = tropical climate = ha1300_climate_tropical_monsoon climate = ha1300_climate_highland_monsoon climate = ha1300_climate_savanna climate = hot_semi_arid climate = cold_semi_arid } OR = { topography = flatland topography = ha1300_topo_valleys topography = hills } } } } value = 5 }
	else_if = { limit = { OR = { OR = { topography = wetlands topography = ha1300_topo_floodplains topography = ha1300_topo_deltas } OR = { vegetation = ha1300_veg_marsh vegetation = ha1300_veg_swamp } AND = { OR = { climate = continental climate = ha1300_climate_continental_monsoon climate = ha1300_climate_dry_summer_continental climate = oceanic climate = ha1300_climate_subpolar_oceanic climate = mediterranean climate = subtropical climate = ha1300_climate_subtropical_monsoon climate = tropical climate = ha1300_climate_tropical_monsoon climate = ha1300_climate_highland_monsoon climate = ha1300_climate_savanna climate = hot_semi_arid climate = cold_semi_arid } OR = { topography = flatland topography = ha1300_topo_floodplains topography = wetlands topography = ha1300_topo_deltas topography = ha1300_topo_valleys topography = hills topography = ha1300_topo_rolling topography = plateau } } } } value = 5 }
	else_if = { limit = { OR = { has_river = yes is_adjacent_to_lake = yes OR = { topography = ha1300_topo_deltas topography = ha1300_topo_floodplains topography = ha1300_topo_valleys } AND = { has_location_modifier = pp_wb_coastal OR = { topography = flatland topography = wetlands } } } } value = 5 }
	else_if = { limit = { OR = { AND = { has_location_modifier = pp_wb_coastal OR = { topography = flatland topography = wetlands topography = ha1300_topo_deltas topography = ha1300_topo_floodplains topography = hills topography = ha1300_topo_valleys } } OR = { topography = wetlands topography = ha1300_topo_deltas } } } value = 5 }
	else_if = { limit = { OR = { AND = { OR = { climate = arid climate = cold_arid } has_river = no NOT = { is_adjacent_to_lake = yes } } AND = { OR = { climate = hot_semi_arid climate = cold_semi_arid } OR = { vegetation = desert vegetation = ha1300_veg_scrubland vegetation = sparse } has_river = no NOT = { is_adjacent_to_lake = yes } } } } value = 5 }
}
